projects.title: Bear Lodge Rare Earth Project
projects.description: Rare Element Resources Inc. has submitted a Mine Plan of Operations to the Black Hills National Forest. The project proposes to develop an open-pit mine with associated infrastructure and support facilities. The project also includes reclamation, monitoring, mitigation, and closing.

projects.title: Benchmark Vegetation Management
projects.purpose: Forest Products|Fuels Management|Vegetation Management (Other Than Forest Products)
projects.description: This project would provide commercial timber products to local industry and would reduce fire hazard and the risk of insect infestation in the wildland urban interface. Non-commercial harvest to reduce fuels and maintain hardwood and meadows would also occur.

projects.title: Comanche Park Campground Improvements
projects.description: Project to modernize USFS Comanche Campground facilities and grounds to improve visitor experience, meet recreational demands, and ensure a safe and sustainable operation.

projects.title: Forestwide Well Decommissioning Project
projects.description: The proposed action is to decommission unused, abandoned, and unneeded water wells across the Mystic and Hell Canyon Ranger Districts of the Black Hills National Forest.

projects.title: Frass Forest Health EA
projects.description: Project to primarily salvage harvest beetle infected and/or killed trees to reduce the extent of a rapidly spreading bark beetle infestation and recover value of beetle-hit trees; increase forest health resiliency and reduce risk of wildfire.

projects.title: Glen Erin Dam Removal
projects.description: Project on Hell Canyon Ranger District to restore stream hydrology and function to approximately 0.2 miles of Glen Erin Creek through the removal of a deteriorated concrete gravity bottom structure, regrading the creek channel, and streambank reshaping.

projects.title: Grizzly Prescribed Burn
projects.purpose: Fuels Management|Vegetation Management (Other Than Forest Products)
projects.description: Collaborative prescribed burn with Mount Rushmore to promote forest health and improve wildfire resilience. Additionally, protect recreational residences through thinning activities.

projects.title: Hill West LLC FLPMA Special Use Permit Project (Bird Lode)
projects.purpose: Land Ownership Management|Road Management|Special Use Management
projects.description: The proposed action is to issue both a Forest FLPMA Road Use Permit and a Private FLPMA Road Use Permit authorizing access across NFS lands.

projects.title: Hill West LLC FLPMA Special Use Permit Project (Little Giant Lode)
projects.description: Hills West LLC is requesting authorization to maintain, plow, and use National Forest System (NFS) roads to access private property located off NFSR 354.1B, as well as authorization for a private road use permit across NFS lands to provide legal access to the property.

projects.title: Jackalope Forest Management Project
projects.description: The Jackalope Forest Management Project proposes vegetation management and restoration treatments, including commercial harvest, thinning, prescribed fire, fuels reduction, conifer encroachment treatments, habitat restoration, watershed improvements, and associated connected improvements.

projects.title: Merztiotis Mining LLC FLPMA Special Use Permit Project
projects.description: Merztiotis Mining LLC is requesting authorization for a Private FLPMA Road Use Permit to provide legal access to private property located off NFSR 389 and NFSR 389.1G.

projects.title: Newark Exploratory Drilling Project
projects.description: F3 Gold, LLC of Minneapolis, MN USA proposing an exploratory drilling project to be completed within one year and on less than 5 acres of National Forest System land.

projects.title: October Jinx Project
projects.description: Authorization to Clean Nuclear Energy Corps for short term (1 year or less) exploratory drilling in search of uranium mineralization and aquifer testing on NFS lands located approximately 7.5 miles north of Edgemont, SD.

projects.title: Rattlesnake Randy Placer Mine Excavation Project
projects.purpose: Minerals And Geology|Recreation Management|Special Use Management
projects.description: Rattlesnake Randy (John Randall Nelson) is requesting authorization to conduct small-scale placer mining activities on National Forest System (NFS) lands under a Plan of Operations. Proposed activities include excavation to bedrock. No milling, processing, structures, or permanent facilities.

projects.title: Ridge Forest Management
projects.purpose: Forest Products|Fuels Management|Vegetation Management (Other Than Forest Products)
projects.description: Forest management actions including commercial and non-commercial timber removal, hardwood and meadow enhancement, and prescribed fire.

projects.title: Roby Forest Management Project
projects.purpose: Forest Products|Fuels Management|Vegetation Management (Other Than Forest Products)|Watershed Management
projects.description: The Roby Forest Management Project proposes timber harvest, fuel reduction, prescribed fire, road improvements, meadow restoration, and riparian restoration activities.
